source: Derived measurement/investigation report, not a cited anatomical entity. Underlying anatomical facts for the vessels referenced are from each vessel's own data/vascular/*.json record, which cites Gray's Anatomy for Students 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell) and Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998).
method: Generalizes Q118/Q121/Q122's real-bone-attachment connector feasibility method to data/vascular/'s 388 unshipped entities (of 412 total, per Q117's own completeness audit, re-confirmed unchanged by this item via scripts/recount_tissue_gaps.py --type vascular). Three-step strict filter per this item's own mandate: (a) is the vessel's own real anatomical description a short, essentially direct course (not curving/branching/anastomosing)? (b) do both endpoints resolve to real coordinates via the existing data/rig/anchors.json + data/skeleton/bones.json + scripts/audit_landmarks_vs_geometry.py:build_frames() system? (c) is there a real cited reference diameter? Filter (b) is a hard structural blocker for every one of the 388: unlike tendons/ligaments (schema/tendon.schema.json, schema/ligament.schema.json), which carry an attachments.{proximal,distal}_attachment.ref field naming a specific bone by id, vessel records (schema/vessel_branch.schema.json) carry no attachment field at all -- only parent_id (vessel-to-vessel tree topology) and free-text notes. The schema's own path_via_points_mm field (a list of {landmark, bone_frame, position_local_mm}), seemingly designed for exactly this purpose, is populated on 0 of 412 vessel records (checked directly). data/rig/anchors.json (300 entries) is 100% muscle_origin/muscle_insertion, 0 vascular -- this project's anchor-generation pipeline (scripts/generate_anchors.py) has never produced a vascular anchor of any kind.

text_screen_of_388_unshipped_notes_field.method: Keyword scan of each unshipped vessel's own 'notes' field. This is a text screen ONLY (filter (a) proxy), run for transparency before the hard filter (b) blocker above was found to eliminate all 388 regardless. A vessel classified here as not curvy-flagged is NOT thereby a candidate -- see filter_b on every per-entity row, which fails unconditionally.
text_screen_of_388_unshipped_notes_field.note_on_the_14_direct_language_hits: All 14 unshipped entities whose notes use short/direct/straight are either lymph node clusters (point-like nodal groups, not cord-shaped vessels: perforator_veins, popliteal_lymph_nodes, paratracheal_lymph_nodes, lumbar_lymph_nodes, perforator_veins_forearm) or vessels described relative to another VESSEL junction rather than a bone landmark (gonadal_v 'drains directly into the IVC'; common_femoral_v 'the segment between the saphenofemoral junction and the inguinal ligament' -- genuinely short and real, but the saphenofemoral junction has no coordinate anywhere in this project's bone-frame system). None reach filter (b).

conclusion: 0 of 388 unshipped vascular entities pass this technique's feasibility filter. This is not merely 'few qualify' (Q121's ligament result, 0/83 after a real per-entity resolvability check) -- it is a structural mismatch one level deeper: ligaments and tendons at least HAVE a bone-attachment field that sometimes resolves; vessels have no such field on any entity, and the one schema field built for a vessel's course (path_via_points_mm) has never been populated for a single one of 412 records. Generating ANY vessel geometry this way would require inventing either a new attachment-to-bone claim not present in the vessel's own real anatomical description, or fabricating path_via_points_mm coordinates from scratch -- both forbidden by this item's own hard constraint against inventing a coordinate or a course shape. A curved-path / via-points model, populated from a real source for a short list of vessels genuinely described as running close to bone (e.g. common_femoral_v's saphenofemoral-junction-to-inguinal-ligament segment, popliteal_a through the adductor hiatus, the carotid bifurcation region), is a real, scoped, but NOT YET BUILT future lever -- distinct from and more work than the straight-chord technique this project already has, since it would need a new vessel-junction anchor type this pipeline has never produced, not just a bone-landmark lookup.
